verdict.rationale: Agent Studio lets a user describe a use case and have it auto-generate a production-ready voice agent without manual prompt engineering, which is a form of in-product AI assistance for building tasks, but this is narrow (agent creation only) rather than a general-purpose in-product assistant for delegating arbitrary tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a general conversational assistant inside the dashboard for broader task delegation (e.g., editing, debugging, analytics via chat), and independent/hands-on confirmation of Agent Studio's behavior.
